title: Conditioning LLMs on Social Value Orientation improves behavioural alignment in a sequential social dilemma
reasoning: The paper investigates the alignment of LLMs with human behavior using Social Value Orientation (SVO), which measures the weight individuals give to the welfare of others (prosociality and altruism). By testing these models in social dilemmas, the paper fundamentally evaluates societal values, value systems, and prosocial ethical behaviors in language models.
